entities.summary: Hywel ap Caradog or Hywel Farf-fehinog was King of Gwynedd. He rose to power following a destructive dynastic struggle in which he deposed King Cynan Dindaethwy. During Hywel's reign, Gwynedd's power was largely confined to Anglesey. It was a time of substantial territorial loss to Mercia.
